references.title: Gameplay HUD
references.source: User-provided image (sent to Claude in chat), added by Claude 2026-10-12
references.notes: Top-left portrait with name/level/class, HP/MAG/EXP bars and buff icons; top-right zone name, day/time and round runic minimap with compass; right-side parchment quest list and Great Sage assistant panel; bottom-left event log (Voice of the World/Combat/System); bottom-center hotbar (1-6, Q, E) with skill icons and EXP strip. Sample names/stats/quests are illustrative, not game data.
